findings.title: Model-only Knowledge QA runs on the owner session, so DCS/context state and prompt persistence leak across turns
findings.reason: QA now uses an independent agent session and the Main-owned workspaceId/workspaceDir; Electron verifies unchanged owner history.

findings.title: `respondWithEvidence` returns the previous run's final text when the current run produced none
findings.reason: The dedupe lookup uses the exact current runId. Current QA does not read owner chat.history; the review body also concludes this is not actionable.

findings.title: `knowledgeScope: 'none'` turns with references send `none` scope to the gateway, which normalizes to `none`, so the conflict-group completion test path is exercised but the scope may be inconsistent with Main
findings.reason: Explicit source pins are resolved through owners independently of automatic scope; none/suggest disables automatic retrieval. Off interaction policy is specified separately in RAG-11.

findings.title: `selectKnowledgeModelSources` counts references, not conflict groups, so a group larger than the limit is dropped even when its first members fit
findings.reason: The eight-reference transport cap and whole-group drop are the specified contract, and the large Source Set regression verifies this behavior.

findings.title: `retainedKnowledgeManifest` matches retained units by exact message equality, so re-projected knowledge that changes order or text is silently dropped from the manifest
findings.reason: The manifest intentionally includes only exact complete retained messages; changed or removed projections are excluded. The review body identifies no concrete defect.

findings.title: DCS knowledge projection is not charged when it is re-emitted on a reopened collection, so the shared budget can be exceeded across model calls
findings.reason: Knowledge packing passes allowTruncation=false. The review body corrects its own boolean interpretation and concludes whole-unit drop is implemented.

findings.title: `agent.wait` evidence/text is gated on scope check performed per call, but the snapshot store is process-global and keyed only by runId
findings.reason: operator.read already authorizes session history and context reads. agent.wait checks that same scope before returning content; no removed authorization check was shown.

findings.title: `agent.wait` waits again inside the response for terminal dedupe, which can extend the RPC well past `timeoutMs`
findings.reason: Final-result synchronization subtracts elapsed time from the original timeout and therefore cannot add a second full timeout.

findings.title: Knowledge QA validates claims against `evidence.modelSources`, but those sources are from the pre-model read and not the exact retained set
findings.reason: Quote validation now uses the post-model owner read filtered against retained intentId and chunkDigest, with a source-change regression.

findings.title: Chat resend preserves `_knowledgeRefs` and scope/mode on the optimistic message but the queue/drain path drops scope/mode for resend-then-queue
findings.reason: Resend is blocked during an active run and its queued/send options preserve references, scope and mode. The review body confirms both forwarding paths.

findings.title: Conflict-group completeness in `revalidateChatKnowledgeRefs` uses `refId` membership while intents may map to different refIds after re-read
findings.reason: Group completeness now uses intentId with refId fallback, matching the admission identity.

findings.title: Task Ledger test no longer exercises the real path: `selectSessionTask` is stubbed and the assertion only checks the stub
findings.reason: The fixture verifies the Main dispatch boundary selects its persisted session task before RPC. It passes; the claimed never-reached path is contradicted by execution.
